page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.m1.medium is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.m1 server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and runs on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 4 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs) paired with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through attached network block storage. It operates without any integrated graphics processing units (GPUs) and does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.m1.medium is designed for general-purpose workloads. It is suitable for applications such as mid-tier web servers, application hosting, development environments, and small-scale databases. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation provides predictable compute performance for standard business applications without the resource contention typical of shared-core or burstable instances.
